text.description_html:
First Impressions Clear Acrylic Door Handles

Pair of back to back mounted (1 handle for each side of a door) crystal clear acrylic door handles. Perfect for sauna doors, wine room doors and glass doors.

Made in the USA by the master craftsmen at First Impressions from the finest clear acrylic available. The acrylic is manufacture with UV inhibitors to prevent yellowing and fading.

Specifications for First Impressions PR-CFRBAC Clear Acrylic Door Handles

  • Pull Handle Diameter: 1"
  • Total Projection: 2-7/8"
  • Overall Length: 84"
  • Pull Handle Material: Clear Acrylic
  • Pull Bracket Material: Solid Brass
  • Pull Bracket Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze/Lithonia
  • Number of Brackets: 3

Note: These clear acrylic door handles are handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including different center to center mounting distances and Other Lengths. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Packaged with Back to Back mounting (2 door pulls bolted to each other - 1 door pull for each side of a door). Includes lock down threaded rosettes to securely tighten the door pulls to the door.
Also available: Individual First Impressions CFRBAC Clear Acrylic Door Pull for one side of a door.

*Sold as a Pair (2 Door Pulls) with Back to Back mounting.
